rejected_criterion: Require composed output to remain numerically equal to each isolated component target on its projection.
reason: For valid additive overlap, the composed output must differ from each isolated component target because both residuals are intentionally present. Comparing the composition to each isolated target is a category error and creates false negatives.

requirements: composition must improve the preregistered mixed task over the best single adapter
each source adapter must remain accurate when evaluated alone after composition capability is enabled
removed: component_projection_mse of composed output against isolated component target
